SHOW_IN_TOAST: Copy and show in a toast
SHOW_IN_TOAST_SUBTITLE: Copies the translation and shows it in a notification
SHOW_INLINE_SUBTITLE: Adds the translation below the message text until you pick Show Original
SHOW_LANGUAGES_SUBTITLE: End a translation in the message with its languages, such as (en -> de)
LANGUAGE_FLAGS_SUBTITLE: Use flag emojis instead of language codes where a language has one
LOGIN_INVALID_PAYLOAD: Discord login returned an invalid payload.
NO_REFRESH_TOKEN: No refresh token configured. Open plugin settings and complete login.
REFRESH_INVALID_PAYLOAD: Auth refresh returned an invalid payload.
TRANSLATE_INVALID_PAYLOAD: Translation API returned an unexpected payload.
